[HIGH] TASK_STALLED
subject: protection_step
reason: STALL_BOUND_EXCEEDED
at: 2026-10-09T03:00:00Z
What happened: A live task has been running longer than its bound (TASK_STALLED, STALL_BOUND_EXCEEDED). The subject line of the header names the task.
Position: A position may be open, with or without a stop. While the protection step is stalled, a new fill may wait for its stop.
System already did: The task was not stopped or restarted, nothing was cancelled and nothing was re-sent (a placement is never re-sent). The stall is recorded in the journal.
You must: Check the process log and the exchange position and its stop now, and close or protect the position if it needs it. Restart the process if the task does not finish.
